descriptions.f11c_hierarchy_801a69a8: Evaluate the observed hierarchy filter: mode0 returns whether its stored result is zero; mode1 rejects either of two witnessed descriptor ancestry chains before scanning configured descriptor pointers, and other modes scan directly. Query the object type virtually, walk parent links at offset20 until a target or self-linked root is reached, select a matching configured type, and optionally invoke the stored callback with the negated selection and context, returning whether its result is zero. The explicit reject helper preserves the boolean API boundary; case2 has the same scan behavior as the default. Descriptor24-byte and object/filter layouts are partial observed views, not complete class-size claims; all semantic names and types are inferred. External descriptors remain externally owned.
